candidate_workaround: Preflight every witness for retained_negative_ids and independent_reproduction before appending; when a method was already recorded, resume from its first missing witness rather than duplicating it.
failure_signature: The first M16 fail witness omitted independent_reproduction and was rejected after M16 had entered candidate state.
recurrence_guard: Validate required witness fields before ledger invocation and inspect method state before resuming a partial sequence.
rollback: Retain the rejected witness, preserve the already-recorded candidate method, and append only missing valid events.
scope_boundary: Same-owner Method Flow recovery only; no scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Resume append-only Method Flow after witness-schema rejection
trigger_preconditions: A method record succeeded but its first witness failed schema validation.
